{{Term/Store|Malanya||Series, BotW, TotK, AoC}} is a recurring character in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite|Malanya|Game Screen|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Malanya|Game Screen|TotK}}</ref><ref name="AoC Gallery">{{Cite|Malanya, who only joined the fight at the urging of the four sisters, deserves an offering in return for all of his help... Gather precious stones to craft a pendant that would suit him.|Gallery (Interface)|AoC}}</ref>

==Biography==
==={{BotW|-}}===
Malanya is the god who watches over the [[Horse]]s of the world.<ref name="Malanya">{{Cite|My name is {{Color BotW|Blue|Malanya}}. I am the god who watches over the {{Color BotW|Red|horses}} of this world.|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> He makes his home in the [[Faron (Region)|Faron]] [[Region]] in [[Malanya Spring]], near the [[Lake of the Horse God]]. While he has a strange sense of humor about reviving Horses, he will not harm those who truly care for them.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote=|book= CaC |publisher= |page= 141}}</ref>

When first visited, Malanya is found trapped inside the bud of his Spring. He begs [[Link]] to listen to his story.<ref>{{Cite|{{Small|Boy...}} Sweet boy... Please... Listen to my story...|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> If Link agrees, Malanya introduces himself and asks if he has ever lost one of his Horses.<ref>{{Cite|[Sure.] I am Malanya... Hast thou... I mean... Have you ever felt the pain of losing a horse companion?|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> Malanya claims that if his power is restored, he will be able to help Link.<ref>{{Cite|If my power is returned to me, I may be able to help you out in some way...|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> In order to regain his power, Malanya requires 1,000 [[Rupee]]s.<ref>{{Cite|So please... I beg of you... Help me regain the power I've lost... All I need is {{Color BotW|Red|1,000 rupees}}... When my power has been restored, I should be able to be of use to you, who loves horses so.|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> His hand will appear from inside the bud, and he will ask Link to hand over his Rupees.<ref>{{Cite|Now... You have rupees for me, right? Hand then over. Quickly! In order for me to regain my power, I need {{Color BotW|Red|1,000 rupees}}.|Malanya|BotW}}</ref>

If Link agrees to the payment, Malanya will thank him.<ref>{{Cite|[Here you go.] Thank you. You are too kind.|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> Malanya Spring will then open, and Malanya's power will be restored.<ref>{{Cite|Nwaaaaaagh... I...am... Revived!!|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> Malanya himself then emerges from the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and he remarks on how free he feels.<ref>{{Cite|Ho ho ho... At last! Free of that tiny bud after so long! If my arms were corporeal, they'd have cramped for sure!|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> He recognizes Link as the one who set him free.<ref>{{Cite|And you're the one who set me free, are you not?|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> Malanya then properly introduces himself to Link, explaining he presides over the Horses of the world.<ref name="Malanya"/> Since Link helped, Malanya believes he should grant Link a reward.<ref>{{Cite|I suppose you deserve a {{Color BotW|Red|reward}} for setting me free... What shall I do...|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> Malanya considers eating him for a meal, which causes Link to take on a defensive stance.<ref>{{Cite|{{Big|Shall I make you my meal?!}}|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> However, Malanya reveals that he is joking.<ref>{{Cite|Hahaha, I only jest...|Malanya|BotW}}</ref>

Malanya explains that if one of Link's Horses is killed, he will be able to revive it.<ref>{{Cite|If a horse you love passes away from some sort of tragic, fatal accident, it is within my power to revive that horse...|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> This only works on Horses that have been registered at a [[Stable]]. He warns Link that if he believes the Horse's death was by his own hands, he will be subject to his wrath.<ref>{{Cite|However... If I detect vile intent behind the death of your horse... {{Big|You will suffer my wrath!}}|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> Claiming to be joking once again, Malanya takes a look at Link's Horses.<ref>{{Cite|I only jest... Let me see...|Malanya|BotW}}</ref>

On subsequent visits to Malanya Spring, Malanya will recognize Link when he emerges from the Water.<ref>{{Cite|It's you again...|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> He asks Link why he has returned, and he takes a look at Link's Horses to ensure their wellbeing.<ref>{{Cite|Why have you sought me out? Surely no ill has befallen your beloved, faithful steeds... Let me see|Malanya|BotW}}</ref>

Should Link not have any dead Horses, Malanya claims that all seems well.<ref>{{Cite|...Hrm! I see you're good with horses. All seems to be well.|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> If Link has a high bond with one of his Horses, Malanya notes that they have an extraordinary friendship.<ref>{{Cite|The friendship you established with a horse really is extraordinary.|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> He reminds Link that his Horses care for him, just as he does for them.<ref>{{Cite|Remember that such a friendship is a two-way road. Horses care for you as much as you do for them.|Malanya|BotW}}</ref>

Alternatively, if Link does not have any Horses registered when he speaks to Malanya, he will be shocked.<ref>{{Cite|...Whoa. Do you really not own a single horse?|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> Malanya cannot imagine going through life without a Horse, but he supposes this is how Link lives his life.<ref>{{Cite|I can't imagine going through the world without a faithful steed to keep me company... To each their own, I suppose.|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> He is unable to do anything to help those who have decided to avoid Horses.<ref>{{Cite|In that case, I, the god of horses, can not do much for you who avoids horses for some reason.|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> However, if Link ever does befriend a Horse that later dies, Malanya tells him to come see him.<ref>{{Cite|If you ever do bond with a horse and then tragedy strikes that proud friend, you should come see me.|Malanya|BotW}}</ref>

If one of Link's Horses has died, Malanya will be able to tell.<ref>{{Cite|...Neigh! A horse, loyal and true, has fallen during your adventures!|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> In anger, he threatens to end Link.<ref>{{Cite|{{Big|I could end you, right here and now!}}|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> He quickly calms down, revealing this to be another joke, and he asks Link if he would like the Horse to be revived.<ref>{{Cite|I jest, of course... Shall I bring a companion back to travel with you once more?|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> If Link agrees, Malanya will ask him to choose among his deceased Horses.<ref>{{Cite|Select a loyal friend to bring back...|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> Depending on how Link's Horse died, Malanya will have differing reactions to Link's request.

If Link's Horse died to a [[Guardian]], Malanya will be moved by how well it served its master.<ref>{{Cite|Hrm... You want to revive this horse? It seems this brave animal spent its last moments in a fight with a Guardian. It served its master well. I'm so moved...|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> However, Malanya becomes angry that Link was not able to control his Horse well enough to save its life.<ref>{{Cite|Alas, if you had managed to control this loyal beast with more skill... {{Big|I wouldn't have to revive it!}}|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> Malanya then claims to be joking, and he asks Link if he is certain he wants to revive this Horse.<ref>{{Cite|I jest... This must have been one brave friend. Would you like to revive it and return it to your side?|Malanya|BotW}}</ref>

If Link's Horse died due to an explosion, Malanya will be saddened by its manner of death.<ref>{{Cite|Hrm... Would you like to revive this horse? Oh, goodness! It was caught in an explosion? Poor soul...|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> While he does not want to cast unwarranted doubt on Link, he wonders if he actually killed his Horse.<ref>{{Cite|Not to cast suspicion where none is warranted, but...you didn't kill the horse, did you?|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> However, Malanya decides this could not be, and he asks Link again if he wants to revive the Horse.<ref>{{Cite|It couldn't be the case. I'll give you the benefit of the doubt. Would you like to revive this horse?|Malanya|BotW}}</ref>

If Link's Horse was killed by him, Malanya will be shocked.<ref>{{Cite|So... You would like to revive this horse? This one, specifically? I can do that, of course! But... What is this...|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> He asks Link if he only wants to revive his Horse so he can kill it again, and he accuses Link of thinking of Horses only as tools that can be discarded.<ref>{{Cite|This horse says that YOU killed it! You! How could you?! Do you plan to revive it just to kill it again? Are horses only a tool to you? Do you treat their noble lives so casually that you'd use them and throw them away?|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> Malanya claims that if he were a Horse, he would kick Link in the chest.<ref>{{Cite|If I were a horse right now... {{Big|I'd kick you in the chest!}}|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> After claiming to be joking again, Malanya asserts that Link likely struck his Horse on accident, and he asks for confirmation that Link would like to revive his "temporarily betrayed" friend.<ref>{{Cite|I...jest. You accidentally struck the horse, I'm sure. Would you like to revive this loyal, temporarily betrayed friend?|Malanya|BotW}}</ref>

If Link's Horse died in any other manner, Malanya will call it an accident, which he assures Link happen sometimes.<ref>{{Cite|Hrm. I can tell that this horse died due to an unexpected accident. Worry not, this happens from time to time.|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> He claims that the Horse knows that its death was not Link's intention, and he asks Link if he is certain that this is the Horse he wants to revive.<ref>{{Cite|The horse knows that you did not mean for this to happen. Would you like for me to revive this horse?|Malanya|BotW}}</ref>

When Link once again confirms his decision to revive his Horse, Malanya will then attempt to bring it back.<ref>{{Cite|Ah, understood! Let me bring back this horse!|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> He will then wave his hands in the air and spin his head, after which the selected Horse will appear nearby. After this, Malanya proclaims that he was successful in reviving the Horse.<ref>{{Cite|I was successfully able to bring back the horse!|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> In the future, Malanya reminds Link to take good care of his Horses, as they are supposed to be partners.<ref>{{Cite|Next time, don't let the horse die! Horses are your partners. Don't forget that.|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> He warns Link that he will regret it if he is careless with them.<ref>{{Cite|If you're careless with their lives, you may regret it... {{Big|UNDERSTAND?}}|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> Malanya claims that he is only joking for now.<ref>{{Cite|I jest... For now!|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> At the end of their conversation, Malanya will collapse and fall back into his Spring.

When Link makes another visit to Malanya Spring, Malanya will be shocked that he has come back to revive another Horse.<ref>{{Cite|Oh, you again... You didn't come here to revive a horse again, did you?|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> He explains that he only helped Link for free the first time due to the fact that he freed him, but he is too busy to always be available to him.<ref>{{Cite|I felt I was in your debt before since you freed me from that bud and all...but you didn't think I'd always help out, right? {{Big|I'm very busy!}}|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> However, Malanya reveals that if Link were to bring him something, he would continue to revive his Horses.<ref>{{Cite|I jest. I feel that there is respect in your heart... If you bring me something, I would consider helping you once more.|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> At Link's confusion, Malanya reveals that he needs [[Endura Carrot]]s, which he has only eaten once.<ref>{{Cite|[Some...thing?] I may not look the part, but I am the {{Color BotW|Red|god of horses}}. I need that uh...that thing... A kind of carrot... One I've only eaten once in all my many years... An {{Big|{{Color BotW|Blue|endura carrot}}!}} That is what I ask of you. Fulfill this request and I will consider helping you.|Malanya|BotW}}</ref> When Link hands over an Endura Carrot, Malanya will agree to revive one of his Horses.<ref>{{Cite|[I have one now!] I see you have an {{Color BotW|Blue|endura carrot}}. Allow me to revive your horse.|Malanya|BotW}}</ref>

==={{TotK|-}}===
After the [[Upheaval]], Malanya has relocated his [[Malanya Spring|Spring]] to [[Akkala]], on a peninsula within [[Bloodleaf Lake]] near [[East Akkala Stable]]. Initially, he will stay inside Malanya Spring, but he will leave when [[Link]] gives him an [[Endura Carrot]].<ref>{{Cite|Someone... please... Feed me an {{Color TotK|Red|endura carrot|link}}...|Malanya|TotK}}</ref>

After receiving the Endura Carrot, Malanya will grant [[Horse]]-related wishes for Link in exchange for food.<ref>{{Cite|In exchange, I can {{Color TotK|Red|grant your wishes}}... Those related to horses, at least.|Malanya|TotK}}</ref> In addition to resurrecting dead Horses in exchange for a [[Roasted Endura Carrot]], Malanya now offers to enhance a Horse's stats if given certain [[Meal]]s.<ref>{{Cite|I want some of those... What are they called again? {{Color TotK|Red|Meals}}! Bring me some of those, and I'll grant your wishes.|Malanya|TotK}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|"The god of horses cannot revive on an empty stomach." Generation after generation has repeated that saying. It means that if you want me to enhance or revive a virtuous steed, you must give me food.|Malanya|TotK}}</ref> However, he cannot enhance the stats of [[Epona]], the [[Giant Horse]], or [[Giant White Stallion]], claiming it does not want their abilities enhanced.<ref>{{Cite|Hm? This steed says it does not want to have its abilities enhanced. I see that the horse has the noble air about it. As its companion, it is your duty to always respect its feelings.|Malanya|TotK}}</ref> Each trait can be upgraded to five stars at maximum, at which point Malanya claims the Horse will become too powerful if he continues.<ref>{{Cite|That ability cannot be enhanced any more than it already is. I can only enhance horses to a certain point, you understand. Lest they become more powerful than even me.|Malanya|TotK}}</ref>

Malanya is also featured on the [[Horse-God Fabric]], unlocked at five [[Pony Point]]s. He also delivers messages to those who sleep in a [[Malanya Bed]], unlocked at seven Pony Points.

==Other Appearances==
==={{AoC|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
In {{AoC}}, Malanya appears in one variation of the [[Great Fairy|Great Fairies]]' [[Weak Point Smash]], where he summons an army of [[Horse]]s to trample the enemy. 

In the "[[Shimmering Horseshoe]]" [[Quest]], it is revealed he joined the battle at the request of the four sisters,<ref name="AoC Gallery"/> and receives a horseshoe pendant as an offering in return.<ref>{{Cite|Craftsmen were commissioned to fashion a massive horseshoe pendant covered in diamonds. Malanya's reaction was mixed at first...but then he offered to show everyone his ultimate move.|Gallery (Interface)|AoC}}</ref> He is also mentioned in the "[[Lushify the Spring]]" Quest as appearing pleased by having more visitors due to added plants around the [[Great Fairy Fountain]]s.<ref>{{Cite|The colorful plants brought a raft of visitors to the Great Fairy Fountains! Now receiving more visitors than ever before, Malanya and the four sisters all appeared quite cheery indeed.|Gallery (Interface)|AoC}}</ref>
{{Noncanon|End}}

==Trivia==
* Malanya's music theme is a combination of "[[Epona's Song]]" and the "[[Great Fairy's Fountain Theme]]."
